purpose: Subject fields and their areas. The map's labels sit at one level of abstraction: zoomed out it names fields (algebraic number theory, algebraic geometry, analysis, ...), and zooming into a field reveals its areas. Each area (a galaxy on the map) belongs to one field and takes its colour; the only area of a field with roadmaps is named after the field. Each classification cluster is its own area; an area with primaryMsc takes only the roadmaps of its cluster whose primary subject class starts with one of those prefixes, and the area without primaryMsc takes the rest of that cluster. Where an area lies on the map is measured, not set here: its distance from Mathlib and its direction come from scripts/measure_distances.py (data/roadmap-distances.json and data/galaxy-layout.json), which keeps a field's areas side by side. msc lists the subject-class prefixes whose secondary classes tag a roadmap with this area; the longest matching prefix wins.

galaxies.label: Elementary number theory
caption: Elementary
number theory
galaxies.description: Divisibility, congruences and reciprocity, arithmetic functions, integer sequences and polynomials: the classical arithmetic the rest of number theory assumes.

galaxies.label: Computational number theory
caption: Computational
number theory
galaxies.description: Certified algorithms for arithmetic invariants, and the checks that connect formal statements with arithmetic databases such as the LMFDB.

galaxies.label: Finite fields
caption: Finite fields
galaxies.description: Finite fields and finite rings, character sums and their bounds, and their interfaces with coding theory.

galaxies.label: Analytic number theory
caption: Analytic
number theory
galaxies.description: Zeta and L-functions and the distribution of primes, sieves, exponential sums and the circle method, Diophantine approximation and transcendence, and probabilistic and statistical number theory.

galaxies.label: Number fields and class field theory
caption: Number fields &
class field theory
galaxies.description: Number fields and local fields, ramification, class field theory, Galois cohomology and duality, and quadratic forms and lattices over global and local fields.

galaxies.label: Curves, abelian varieties and Shimura varieties
caption: Curves, abelian &
Shimura varieties
galaxies.description: Elliptic curves and abelian varieties, heights and rational points, Néron models, modular curves and Shimura varieties as moduli spaces, and the finiteness theorems of Diophantine geometry.

galaxies.label: Function fields
caption: Function fields
galaxies.description: Arithmetic of global function fields: Drinfeld modules and t-motives, special values in characteristic p, and shtukas and the Langlands correspondence over function fields.

galaxies.label: Modular and automorphic forms
caption: Modular &
automorphic forms
galaxies.description: Modular forms and their Hecke theory, automorphic forms and representations on reductive groups, locally symmetric spaces, trace formulas, p-adic families, and q-series and mock modular forms.

galaxies.label: Iwasawa theory and special values
caption: Iwasawa theory &
special values
galaxies.description: p-adic L-functions and measures, Euler systems and main conjectures, Heegner points and Gross–Zagier formulas, and the Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer and Bloch–Kato statements about special values.

galaxies.label: Galois representations and modularity
caption: Galois representations
& modularity
galaxies.description: Galois representations attached to automorphic forms, Galois deformation rings, modularity lifting and potential automorphy, p-adic local Langlands, and endoscopic transfer.

galaxies.label: Model theory
caption: Model theory
galaxies.description: Logic in number theory: definability, the model theory of valued fields, and motivic integration.

galaxies.label: Schemes, curves and moduli
caption: Schemes, curves
& moduli
galaxies.description: Schemes and stacks, curves and their Jacobians, moduli and representability, toric varieties, Hodge structures and stable reduction.

galaxies.label: p-adic Hodge theory and p-adic geometry
caption: p-adic Hodge theory
& p-adic geometry
galaxies.description: Adic and perfectoid spaces, diamonds and v-stacks, crystalline, prismatic and A_inf cohomology, p-adic Hodge theory, and the Fargues–Fontaine curve.

galaxies.label: Étale cohomology
caption: Étale
cohomology
galaxies.description: Étale and ℓ-adic cohomology with its duality and operations, weights and the Weil conjectures, vanishing cycles and perverse sheaves, and newer cohomology theories such as Habiro cohomology.

galaxies.label: Motives and algebraic cycles
caption: Motives &
algebraic cycles
galaxies.description: Algebraic cycles and their equivalence relations, and pure and mixed motives.

galaxies.label: Algebraic K-theory
caption: Algebraic
K-theory
galaxies.description: K-groups of rings, schemes and number fields, symbols and Bloch groups, regulators and polylogarithms, trace methods, and the Habiro-ring constructions around finite regulators.

galaxies.label: Geometrisation of local Langlands
caption: Geometrisation of
local Langlands
galaxies.description: The geometrisation of the local Langlands correspondence: bundles on the Fargues–Fontaine curve, Hecke stacks and local shtukas, geometric Satake, and the spectral action.

galaxies.label: Commutative algebra
caption: Commutative
algebra
galaxies.description: Commutative rings and their completions for deformation theory and patching, and cyclotomic completions and Habiro rings.

galaxies.label: Group theory
caption: Group theory
galaxies.description: The classification of finite simple groups, and profinite and pro-p groups.

galaxies.label: Representation theory
caption: Representation
theory
galaxies.description: Representations of finite, compact and Lie groups, Lie algebras and root systems, reductive groups, smooth representations of p-adic groups, and representations of quivers and algebras.

galaxies.label: Homological algebra
caption: Homological
algebra
galaxies.description: Derived and enhanced categories, DG and A∞ structures, stable and curved homological algebra, Grothendieck groups, and the cohomology of profinite groups.

galaxies.label: Library foundations
caption: Library
foundations
galaxies.description: Shared definitions, existing libraries and proof-integrity checks that the roadmaps build on.

galaxies.label: Complex and functional analysis
caption: Complex &
functional analysis
galaxies.description: Complex analysis and conformal mapping, Fuchsian groups, orthogonal bases, operator semigroups, and optimal transport.

galaxies.label: Partial differential equations
caption: Partial differential
equations
galaxies.description: Sobolev spaces, and elliptic and evolution equations.

galaxies.label: Probability
caption: Probability
galaxies.description: Standard probability distributions, and exchangeability and de Finetti's theorem.

galaxies.label: Combinatorics
caption: Combinatorics
galaxies.description: Dense graph limits, additive combinatorics and higher Fourier analysis, and algebraic coding theory.

galaxies.label: Topology
caption: Topology
galaxies.description: Algebraic topology, low-dimensional and geometric topology, Heegaard Floer homology, covering spaces, and quantum invariants of knots and three-manifolds.

galaxies.label: Differential geometry
caption: Differential
geometry
galaxies.description: Riemannian manifolds, geodesics and the exponential map.
